Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The Indoor Unit (IDU) must feature an advanced acoustic enclosure design, maintaining an operational noi se level not exceeding 36 dB(A) at medium fan speed, and a peak operational noise level not exceeding 40 dB(A) at high fan speed for a 1.ton capacity configuration, ensuring low-vibration performance suitable for quiet environments The outdoor unit must utilize 100% inner-grooved copper tubes for both condenser and evaporator coils to maximize heat transfer efficiency. Aluminum or microchannel alloys are structurally rejected. Corrosion Protection: “Coils must be treated with an advanced anti-corrosive, hydrophilic blue-fin/epoxy co ating capable of resisting a minimum of 500 hours of continuous salt spray testing, certified by an NABL-ac credited laboratory report. The inverter compressor and electronic expansion valves must be designed, rated, and certified to deliver sustained cooling capacity without tripping at ambient outdoor temperatures reaching up to 52 degree Cel sius. The unit must incorporate self-diagnostic software via an integrated microprocessor controller, capable of detecting and displaying a minimum of 10 distinct operational error codes (including low refrigerant/leakag e detection, sensor open/short circuits, and high-pressure protection faults) on the digital display or via an official linked smart diagnostic application. .
